steps.label: 2257-own-set-child-actual-apply-prevalidation
command: (() => {if(location.pathname!=='/item/all/modify.donga'||new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089242'||document.querySelector('.modal.show'))throw Error('Own clean modify only');const buttons=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(e=>e.innerText.trim()==='전체 반영'&&e.getClientRects().length);if(buttons.length!==2||buttons.some(e=>e.getAttribute('onclick')!=='itemApplyAll();'||e.matches(':disabled')))throw Error('Expected identical header/footer apply actions');buttons[0].click();return {clickedEntryOnly:true,finalConfirmClicked:false,visibleModals:[...document.querySelectorAll('.modal.show')].map(e=>({id:e.id,text:e.innerText})),alerts:[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=alert]')].map(e=>e.innerText),activeTabs:[...document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tabs [role=tab].active')].map(e=>e.innerText)};})()
